summary: Iteration 3 verified new moderation (extra_*) feature end-to-end plus full regression after dark redesign + 'Banetskaya.by' rebrand. Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/test_contracts_api.py from 19→22 tests; all 22/22 PASS in ~11.5s. New tests: (a) test_moderation_extra_fields_appear_when_filled — POST /api/contracts/preview with all 6 extra_* filled → each marker appears in word/document.xml and no leftover {{ }} or {%p ... %} tags; (b) test_moderation_empty_extras_do_not_appear — with extra_* explicitly '' the markers and 'Дополнительно:' block are absent and no leftover placeholders; (c) test_moderation_persists_via_history — POST /api/contracts with extra_subject/extra_other/note markers, GET /api/contracts/{id} returns them in fields, and /download re-renders them (incl. 'Дополнительно: TEST_HIST_NOTE_QQQ'). Frontend (Playwright vs public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL): brand 'Banetskaya.by' visible in sidebar; nav-dashboard/nav-generate/nav-history/nav-settings + stat-total/stat-month/stat-datasets + dashboard-new-contract-btn/dashboard-open-history-btn all render and navigate. Generate flow: excel-file-input (hidden) accepts xlsx, row shows TEST_UI_Модератор, batch-generate-btn and batch-print-btn present. Clicking the row's exact 'Сформировать' opens edit-contract-dialog with tab-fields + tab-moderation; all 17 field-* incl. field-note and all 6 section-extra_* testids visible. Filling section-extra_subject='TEST_UI_MOD_SUBJ_777' and section-extra_other='TEST_UI_MOD_OTHER_888' then clicking download-docx-btn yields a docx whose word/document.xml contains both markers and has NO leftover '{{' or '{%p' tags. History: history-search filters to created record, per-row testids preview-{id}, dl-docx-{id}, dl-pdf-{id}, print-{id}, delete-{id} all present, history-batch-print-btn + history-batch-download-btn visible; preview-{id} opens document-preview-dialog with preview-iframe + preview-open-tab-btn; delete confirm AlertDialog works and toast 'Договор удалён' displayed. Settings: settings-download-sample-btn visible, 'Поля автозаполнения (17)' with 'Дополнительно (вручную)' entry present.
critical_code_review_comments: document_service.render_docx correctly builds context over ALL_TEMPLATE_KEYS (16 fields + note + 6 extra_*) defaulting missing keys to '' — matches docxtpl {%p if key %} conditionals so empty sections don't emit paragraphs (verified by document.xml diff).

prepare_template.py injects 6 conditional blocks after specific anchor paragraphs; anchors are substrings so they remain fragile to template wording changes. Consider persisting anchor->key mapping in a dedicated config or asserting anchor hits at build time (currently only printed).
server.py stores raw fields dict as-is (extra_* + note persisted); GET /api/contracts/{id} returns them unchanged — good.
History Delete uses a proper AlertDialog (not window.confirm) — good UX consistent with the dark theme.
convert_to_pdf still uses fixed 90s per-doc timeout; batch-print of many docs could exceed request timeout (not observed with 2 docs). Consider async parallelization or streamed conversion.
Files remain well under 700 lines; env-var usage clean; data-testid coverage is thorough across all new moderation controls.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_UI_9999/TEST_UI_Модератор contract created via UI and deleted at end of run. All TEST_MOD_* backend fixtures self-clean. Seeded 45e95300-... contract untouched.

Row 'Сформировать' button is not unique text — batch button also says 'Сформировать выбранные'; use get_by_role('button', name='Сформировать', exact=True) or scope to the table.
